changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO sub_modules (name, code, module_id, enabled, is_sellable, read_only_capable) SELECT 'Saldo a favor del cliente', 'CUSTOMER_CREDIT', (SELECT id FROM modules WHERE code = 'GENERAL'), 1, 0, 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sub_modules WHERE code = 'CUSTOMER_CREDIT');

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO sub_modules (name, code, module_id, enabled, is_sellable, read_only_capable) SELECT 'Medios de pago de suscripción', 'SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_METHOD', (SELECT id FROM modules WHERE code = 'GENERAL'), 1, 0, 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sub_modules WHERE code = 'SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_METHOD');

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO base_permissions (name, code, sub_module_id, enabled) SELECT seed.name, seed.code, sm.id, TRUE FROM ( SELECT 'Ver devoluciones de pago' AS name, 'paymentRefund.read' AS code, 'SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT' AS sub_module_code UNION ALL SELECT 'Ver intentos de cobro', 'paymentAttempt.read', 'SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT' UNION ALL SELECT 'Ver solicitudes de reversión', 'paymentReversalRequest.read', 'SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT' UNION ALL SELECT 'Ver saldo a favor', 'customerCredit.read', 'CUSTOMER_CREDIT' UNION ALL SELECT 'Ver medios de pago', 'subscriptionPaymentMethod.read', 'SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_METHOD' UNION ALL SELECT 'Registrar medio de pago', 'subscriptionPaymentMethod.create', 'SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_METHOD' UNION ALL SELECT 'Revocar/actualizar medio de pago', 'subscriptionPaymentMethod.update', 'SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_METHOD' ) seed JOIN sub_modules sm ON sm.code = seed.sub_module_code LEFT JOIN base_permissions existing ON existing.code = seed.code WHERE existing.id IS NULL;

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM base_permissions WHERE code IN ( 'paymentRefund.read', 'paymentAttempt.read', 'paymentReversalRequest.read', 'customerCredit.read', 'subscriptionPaymentMethod.read', 'subscriptionPaymentMethod.create', 'subscriptionPaymentMethod.update');

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO base_role_permissions (base_role_id, base_permission_id, enabled) SELECT br.id, bp.id, 1 FROM base_roles br JOIN base_permissions bp ON bp.code IN ( 'paymentRefund.read', 'paymentAttempt.read', 'paymentReversalRequest.read', 'customerCredit.read', 'subscriptionPaymentMethod.read', 'subscriptionPaymentMethod.create', 'subscriptionPaymentMethod.update') WHERE br.code = 'ADMIN' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM base_role_permissions x WHERE x.base_role_id = br.id AND x.base_permission_id = bp.id);
changeSet.rollback: DELETE FROM base_role_permissions WHERE base_permission_id IN ( SELECT id FROM base_permissions WHERE code IN ( 'paymentRefund.read', 'paymentAttempt.read', 'paymentReversalRequest.read', 'customerCredit.read', 'subscriptionPaymentMethod.read', 'subscriptionPaymentMethod.create', 'subscriptionPaymentMethod.update'));

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO permissions (name, code, company_id, sub_module_id, enabled) SELECT bp.name, bp.code, ce.company_id, sm.id, 1 FROM company_entitlements ce JOIN sub_modules sm ON sm.id = ce.sub_module_id AND sm.code = 'SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT' CROSS JOIN base_permissions bp WHERE ce.access_level IN ('FULL', 'READ_ONLY') AND bp.code IN ( 'paymentRefund.read', 'paymentAttempt.read', 'paymentReversalRequest.read') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM permissions p WHERE p.company_id = ce.company_id AND p.code = bp.code);

changeSet.author: orlando
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO role_permissions (role_id, permission_id, enabled) SELECT r.id, p.id, 1 FROM roles r JOIN permissions p ON p.company_id = r.company_id AND p.code IN ( 'paymentRefund.read', 'paymentAttempt.read', 'paymentReversalRequest.read') WHERE r.code = 'ADMIN' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM role_permissions rp WHERE rp.role_id = r.id AND rp.permission_id = p.id);
changeSet.rollback: DELETE FROM role_permissions WHERE permission_id IN ( SELECT id FROM permissions WHERE code IN ( 'paymentRefund.read', 'paymentAttempt.read', 'paymentReversalRequest.read'));
